info.title: Exsensic API
info.description: Booking API for Exsensic. Errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with a "code" and a "traceId" (docs/CONTRACTS.md section 7). Any operation can also return 500 server_error. Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/login and send the token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

code.description: A stable, machine-readable error code, for example slot_unavailable.

traceId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem; it links to the server log.

errors.description: Only on validation_failed: the messages for each field.

ApiProblem.description: An RFC 9457 ProblemDetails error. The "code" values are listed in docs/CONTRACTS.md section 7.

Bearer.description: The access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/register.
